episodic_summary: As of 13 September, 2023, Caroline shares with Melanie that she is inspired by seeing the work being done to make a difference for the LGBTQ+ community, expressing her desire to help create a loving world. Caroline feels amazing gratitude for the support she receives from her friends, family, and mentors, which inspires her to keep making art. Melanie responds with admiration, stating that she loves how Caroline's art shows togetherness and the power of conversation. Melanie asks how long Caroline has been creating art, and Caroline reveals that she has been creating art since she was 17 years old, finding it empowering and cathartic, and describing art as an amazing way to show things that are hard to put into words. Melanie shares that she has been into art for seven years now, mentioning that she found real muses in painting and pottery, describing both as calming and satisfying. Caroline explains that painting and drawing have helped her express her feelings and explore her gender identity, stating that creating art has been important during her transition and has helped her understand and accept herself. Melanie expresses gratitude for Caroline's support, stating that art has been a creative outlet and a form of therapy for her. Melanie asks Caroline if she has thought about trying pottery or another art form, and Caroline admits that she hasn't done pottery yet but is game for trying new art forms. Caroline shares an image of a painting on an easel with a red and blue background, and Melanie praises the painting, expressing her love for the colors and asking what inspired Caroline's idea. Caroline explains that the painting represents her path as a trans woman, using red and blue to symbolize the binary gender system and the mix of colors to smash rigid thinking, serving as a reminder to love her authentic self and to be proud of who she is. Melanie expresses her admiration for Caroline's painting and her pride in Caroline for being true to herself, asking how Caroline's journey has affected her relationships.

episodic_summary:
As of 3 July, 2023, Andrew shares with Audrey that he has been finding new hobbies lately, mentioning that he cannot hike and is getting into cooking more, trying new recipes that he finds enjoyable. Andrew asks Audrey if she enjoys cooking and what her favorite recipes are. Audrey enthusiastically responds that she loves cooking and her favorite recipe is Chicken Pot Pie, describing it as cozy and delicious, especially on a cold day. Audrey offers to share the recipe with Andrew if he wants. Andrew expresses his interest, commenting that the pie looks nice and asks what inspired Audrey to make it. Audrey assures Andrew that she will send the recipe shortly and encourages him to give it a try, explaining that it is her family's recipe that has been around for years. Audrey adds that the flavors remind her of her grandma's kitchen and make her think of conversations at the table. Andrew inquires about how cooking is going for Audrey, and she shares that cooking is helping her de-stress and allows her to be creative, describing it as an escape. Andrew agrees, stating that cooking gives an escape and allows him to try something new, plus he enjoys the bonus of enjoying food afterward. Audrey agrees, stating that cooking and eating food is rewarding and likens it to a form of self-care. Audrey expresses her love for throwing on music, pouring a glass of wine, and going with the flow in the kitchen, describing it as therapeutic. Audrey shows Andrew a beautiful dish she made. Andrew comments that it looks great and asks if cooking is calming for her and what her go-to ingredient is in the kitchen. Audrey responds that cooking is calming for her and that garlic is her go-to ingredient, as she loves the smell and taste it adds to dishes. Andrew agrees that garlic is delicious and asks if Audrey has a favorite dish to make with garlic and if she would share the recipe. Audrey responds affirmatively, stating that Roasted Chicken is one of her favorites and that she will send the recipe shortly. Andrew expresses excitement about making it, commenting that it looks amazing and asks what inspired Audrey to create it. Audrey shares that the recipe is based on Mediterranean flavors, describing it as a tasty dish that is easy to make and loaded with healthy ingredients like chicken, garlic, and lemon herbs, calling it her favorite comfort meal. Andrew expresses his appreciation for Audrey sharing the recipe, stating that he is always looking for new meal ideas, especially healthier ones.
